references.text: Psalm 37:21 speaks of the wicked who borrows and does not repay, which reflects the attitude of the servant in Matthew 18:30.
In Matthew 5:25-26, listeners are warned to reconcile with their opponent on the way to court to avoid prison, similar to the consequences faced by the servant in Matthew 18:30.
Luke 12:58-59 also advises reaching an agreement before arriving at court to avoid prison, paralleling the situation in Matthew 18:30.
